blurb: Red Bus Brewing Company is a craft brewery in Folsom, California, offering an ever-changing list of beverages including beer, cider, and wine. They have a taproom with seating in multiple areas and a patio with brick oven pizza from Kombi Pizza Co. They also offer custom-labeled craft beer for events and sell brewing and keg supplies.
